note: Step 1's curation and copied digests, built from a delivery whose Vardemangder file changed elsewhere: OTHER's (register 3, not built) only label changed after review; none of PINNED's or UNPINNED's rows or lists changed. sources.description: Variable 5 (Income) delivers literals A and B as two members of one 2020 edition in PINNED (register 1: members 800, 801) and UNPINNED (register 2: 810, 811). Each member carries two lists that disagree on its one code's label. OTHER (register 3) delivers VALUE (900) with one list, whose only label changed after review.
